# magic-starter-laravel

> A Laravel package that serves authentication, two-factor, social sign-in, profile, teams, notifications, billing and a support desk as Sanctum-token JSON routes (under `api/v1` by default), each behind an opt-in feature toggle and each action replaceable through a contract binding. It is the backend of the Flutter starter `magic_starter`, which calls these routes one to one.

**Stack**: PHP ^8.2 (`ext-gd`, `ext-exif`) · Laravel `illuminate/*` ^12.32|^13.0 · Runtime deps: `laravel/sanctum`, `laravel/socialite` (+ `socialiteproviders/apple`, `socialiteproviders/microsoft`), `laravel/cashier`, `stripe/stripe-php`, `onesignal/onesignal-php-api`, `pragmarx/google2fa`, `bacon/bacon-qr-code`, `firebase/php-jwt`, `sebastian/diff`. Optional: Filament ^4.13.3|^5.8.3, Horizon, Pulse, Telescope, `geoip2/geoip2`.

**Setup**:

```bash
composer require anilcancakir/magic-starter-laravel
php artisan magic-starter:install --features=teams --features=two-factor-authentication
php artisan migrate
```

```php
namespace App\Providers;

use AnilcanCakir\MagicStarter\Contracts\CreatesTeams;
use App\Actions\MagicStarter\CreateTeam; // the host's implementation of CreatesTeams
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        // Replace the default action; the API and the admin panel both call the contract.
        $this->app->bind(CreatesTeams::class, CreateTeam::class);
    }
}
```

`magic-starter:install` options: `--all`, `--features=<key>` (repeatable; an unknown key is dropped silently), `--uuid`, `--no-uuid`, `--route-prefix=`, `--frontend-url=`, `--force`. Passing `--all`, `--features`, `--route-prefix` or `--frontend-url`, or `--no-interaction`, turns every prompt off, the migrate prompt included. It publishes `config/magic-starter.php`, ordered migrations, a `User` model with the package traits (a customised one is kept unless `--force`), the `Team` models and `TeamPolicy` with `teams`, language files and a `UserFactory`.

## API

- `AnilcanCakir\MagicStarter\MagicStarterServiceProvider`: auto-discovered; binds the `Contracts\*` interfaces to their `Actions\*` defaults, loads the routes with each one gated by its feature, registers the named rate limiters (`magic-starter-auth-login` and the rest) and the console commands.
- `Features`: the toggle keys (`teams()`, `twoFactorAuthentication()`, `socialLogin()`, `billing()`, `support()`, ...), `enabled(string)` and one `has...Features()` check per key. Keys live in `config('magic-starter.features')`.
- `MagicStarter`: model resolution `userModel()`, `teamModel()`, `membershipModel()`, `teamInvitationModel()`, `socialAccountModel()`, `billableModel()`, which pick up a published `App\Models\*`; overrides `useUserModel()`, `useTeamModel()`; `ignoreRoutes()`; `serializeUserUsing()`.
- `Contracts\*`: one interface per action (`CreatesUsers`, `UpdatesUserProfiles`, `CreatesTeams`, `InvitesTeamMembers`, `SchedulesUserDeletion`, `SendsOtpCodes`, `WritesEntitlement`, ...). `RespondsToSupport`, `AssistsSupportStaff`, `DescribesSupportPage` and `ReportsUsage` ship unbound and switch their feature path on when the host binds them.
- Traits for the user model: `HasTeams`, `HasGuestSupport`, `HasProfilePhoto`, `HasNotifications`, `TwoFactorAuthenticatable`, `MustVerifyEmail`, `HasSocialAccounts`, `HasEntitlement`; `Support\ConditionallyUsesUuids` for UUID-optional keys.
- `Support\MigrationHelper`: `usesUuids()`, `primaryKey()`, `foreignKey()`, `morphColumns()`, which follow `magic-starter.use_uuids`.
- `NotificationPreferenceRegistry`: the per-type, per-channel preference matrix that gates notification channels.
- Support AI: `Support\SupportAi\Tools\SupportToolRegistry`, the `SupportTool` contract, `UntrustedText`, `ProposeBillingChangeTool`.
- AI prompts and runs: `Support\AiPrompts\PromptRegistry`, the `ResolvesPrompts` and `RecordsAiRuns` contracts.
- Admin panel: `Filament\MagicStarterPlugin` (`horizon()`, `pulse()`, `telescope()`), `Filament\Concerns\AuthorizesAdminPanel`.
- Routes: `src/routes/api.php` (the contract with `magic_starter`), `support.php`, `social.php`, `newsletter.php`, `webhooks.php` (Stripe and RevenueCat).
- Commands: `magic-starter:install`, `magic-starter:purge-deleted-users`, `magic-starter:purge-trashed-teams`, `magic-starter:mail:doctor`, `magic-starter:mail:prune-sends`; with their feature `magic-starter:audit:prune`, `magic-starter:ai-runs:prune`, `billing:manifest`, `billing:doctor`, `billing:reconcile`, `magic-starter:billing:prune`, `magic-starter:billing:expire-grants`, `magic-starter:support:sweep`, `magic-starter:support:doctor`, `magic-starter:support-articles:prune-images`; with Filament `magic-starter:filament:install`, `magic-starter:filament:eject`.

## Platforms

- PHP ^8.2 with `ext-gd` and `ext-exif`; Laravel 12.32 or later, or 13. CI runs Laravel 12 on PHP 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4, the Filament 4 and 5 legs, a leg without Filament, Horizon, Pulse and Telescope, and the support tests on PostgreSQL.
- Filament, Horizon, Pulse and Telescope are optional; their commands and panel tools exist only where the package is installed.

## Rules for agents

- Import from `AnilcanCakir\MagicStarter\`; use `Features`, `MagicStarter`, the contracts, traits and `MigrationHelper` as the public surface.
- Gate code on `Features::enabled()` or a `has...Features()` check: a feature that is off registers none of its routes or commands, so its endpoints answer 404.
- Change behaviour by binding your class to a `Contracts\*` interface in a service provider's `register()`; do not edit the package's actions or controllers. `vendor:publish --tag=magic-starter-stubs` copies skeletons that throw until implemented.
- Resolve models through `MagicStarter::userModel()`, `teamModel()` and `billableModel()`, never a hard-coded class.
- Build columns that reference package tables with `MigrationHelper`, never `$table->id()` or `foreignId()`.
- The package routes join no middleware group; list the host's middleware in `magic-starter.route_middleware` (empty by default).
- Change `src/routes/api.php` and the `magic_starter` client together; the request and response shapes are a shared contract.
- Keep `MAGIC_STARTER_EXTERNAL_ID_PREFIX` (default `user_`) equal to the client's `magic_starter.notifications.external_id_prefix`: OneSignal accepts a mismatch and delivers to nobody.
- Bind `SendsOtpCodes` before `phone-otp` serves real users: the default `LogOtpProvider` only logs the code.
- Schedule `magic-starter:purge-deleted-users`, and `magic-starter:purge-trashed-teams` with `restorable-teams`: the package registers them and schedules neither.
- Never run `vendor:publish --tag=cashier-migrations`: they target `users` with integer keys. The package's replacements follow `billing.billable` (`user` or `team`) and `use_uuids`.
- Laravel Boost installs the `magic-starter-development` skill from `resources/boost/skills/magic-starter-development`; read it before extending the package.

## Docs

- [Installation](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/getting-started/installation.md): the install command, its options and what it publishes.
- [Configuration](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/getting-started/configuration.md): every config key and the feature toggles.
- [Authentication](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/authentication.md): login, registration, password reset, guest, OTP, email verification.
- [Social login](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/social-login.md): the ID token and browser flows, connect and disconnect.
- [Sign-in handoff](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/sign-in-handoff.md): minting and exchanging a one-time sign-in code.
- [Two-factor authentication](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/two-factor-authentication.md): enrolment, confirmation, recovery codes, the challenge.
- [Profile](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/profile.md): profile, password, photos, sessions.
- [Account deletion](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/account-deletion.md): scheduling, the grace period, the purge.
- [Teams](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/teams.md): teams, invitations, roles, restorable delete.
- [Notifications](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/notifications.md): listing, read state, preferences, push.
- [Billing](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/billing.md): the catalogue, both rails, trials, campaigns, the agent commands.
- [Releases](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/releases.md): release notes and the public endpoint.
- [Support desk](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/support.md): conversations, the AI desk, the knowledge base.
- [Support AI tools](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/support-tools.md): writing and registering a support tool.
- [Support proposals](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/support-proposals.md): subscription changes staff approve.
- [Admin panel](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/admin-panel.md): the Filament plugin, the gate, ejecting a resource.
- [Audit trail](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/basics/audit.md): recording, redaction, pruning.
- [AI run log](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/guides/ai-runs.md): recording model calls, cost, masking, pruning.
- [AI prompt overrides](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/guides/ai-prompts.md): registering prompts and the admin workbench.
- [Mail on OneSignal](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/guides/mail-onesignal.md): the transports, routing a mail class, the doctor.
- [Action contracts](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/architecture/action-contracts.md): overriding business logic.
- [Models](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/architecture/models.md): dynamic resolution, UUID support, traits.
- [Service provider](https://anilcancakir.com/magic-starter-laravel/docs/architecture/service-provider.md): bindings, routes, rate limiters.
